## Tribal Protector (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
LE or CE Large magical beast  
**Init** +10; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +20  


**Defense**


**AC** 30, touch 20, flat-footed 23 (+6 Dex, +1 dodge, +10 natural, +4 profane, -1 size)  
**hp** 208 (16d10+48)  
**Fort** +17, **Ref** +20, **Will** +12  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., climb 20 ft.  
**Melee** bite +23 melee (1d8+10/19-20 plus poison)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** nightmare, poison, web (+21 ranged, DC 21, 16 hp, DR 5/—)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 16th; concentration +18)  

Constant—freedom of movement  


**Tactics**


Ebon spiders are prone to charge into combat, trying to kill as many creatures as possible. Being intelligent, they prefer to attack spellcasters over armored opponents, using their Mobility and Spring Attack feats to keep their opponents off-balance.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 22, **Con** 16, **Int** 14, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +24 (+26 bull rush); **CMD** 44 (46 vs. bull rush; 56 vs. trip)  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (bite), Iron Will, Improved Iron Will, Spring Attack, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite), Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +25, Climb +34, Perception +20, Stealth +21; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Climb  
**Languages** Common, Sylvan, Undercommon, and either Abyssal or Infernal (depending on their alignment with law or chaos).  
**SQ** freedom of movement, profane infusion  


**Special Abilities**


**Nightmare (Su)** A creature that fails the secondary saving throw against an ebon spider’s poison is subject to its nightmare effect. Once each year on the anniversary of the spider’s attack, the creature lapses into a comatose state for 24 hours that is marked by sweating, uncontrollable shaking, and vivid dreams that recreate the attack in the mind of the victim. In addition, each time the creature finds itself in the domain of an ebon spider (marked by the massive webs of its dream), the creature suffers a -4 morale penalty on all attack rolls and saving throws. This mind-affecting fear effect can be removed by the remove curse spell or DC 25 break enchantment spell cast within a number of days of the attack equal to the caster’s level. Afterwards, only a miracle or wish spell is sufficient to remove the effect.  

**Poison (Ex)** **Nightmare Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; *save* Fort DC 21, *frequency* 1/round for 2 rounds, *effect* 1d3 Str damage plus nightmare (see above), *cure* 2 saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Profane Infusion (Su)** An ebon spider is infused with profane energy, granting it a +4 profane bonus on its AC and saving throws.  



**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate forests  
**Organization** solitary or cluster (2-5)  
**Treasure** none
